content.title: Browse bouquet catalogue
content.description: A visitor browses the bouquet catalogue and can see the price of each bouquet before deciding whether to add anything to the basket, and this storefront discovery experience must also work on a phone because most customers arrive from Instagram on mobile devices.
content.value: Lets customers discover products and prices before starting an order.
criteria: the price of every bouquet is visible before anything is added to the basket
the storefront flow works on a phone
